title: Humidity Spike Mold-Risk Watch
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zigbee2mqtt:device sensor_type=humidity
| stats latest(humidity_pct) as humidity, latest(temp_c) as temp by room
| where humidity>70 AND temp<22
| sort - humidity
description: Looks for cool rooms with very high humidity, the exact combination that creates mold-friendly conditions in corners, closets, and window frames.
value: Mold risk is a slow problem that starts as a data problem; spotting the damp rooms early is much nicer than discovering it with your eyes later.
implementation: Forward humidity and temperature from room sensors; alert on spaces that stay cool and damp long enough to deserve ventilation or dehumidification.
visualization: Table of rooms by humidity with mold-risk conditions highlighted.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which rooms are damp and cool enough that mold could start becoming a problem.
